title: 第24章 落雁谷
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
从五柳城到落雁谷，骑马两天。

    林尘和苏荇天不亮就出了城门，沿着官道往东北方向走。

    苏荇骑着一匹从徐老头那里借来的老马，马背上驮着那口补丁青铜炉，一路上都在翻看丹道真解第二卷毒理篇，嘴里念念有词。

    “紫鳞果的毒性不在果肉，在果核。果核表面有十二道鳞片灵纹，每片鳞片都是一条独立的小灵纹，入炉后会同时往外释放腐脉之毒。清心草的木属性灵纹遇到火属性鳞片灵纹会互相攻击——木生火，火属性毒性在融合时反而被助长。所以需要银叶花的水属性在中间当缓冲层。”她把书翻到其中一页，上面密密麻麻全是徐老头的批注。

    “水克火，同时水生木。三种药材的配比必须精确到每一株的灵纹密度，错一点都会炸炉。”林尘接过她手里的书看了一眼，又还给她，“你在马上看书不怕头晕？”

    “我炼了三年丹，在炼丹炉旁边被熏得眼泪直流都能继续配药，骑马看书算什么。”苏荇把书合上塞进马背上的褡裢里，“不过我确实有个问题想问你——昨晚在灵境空间里，你说混沌印记激活之后我的灵纹感知能突破到第三层。第三层能主动引导灵纹融合方向，但具体怎么操作？”

    “靠灵力共鸣。你的灵力进入我的经脉之后，混沌灵力会自动反哺回去，在反哺过程中你的感知力会被淬炼。突破到第三层之后，你不需要观火镜就能直接‘看到’炉内灵纹的流转方向，然后通过调整火候来引导它们往你想要的融合路径上走。简单来说，第一层是看颜色，第二层是看速度，第三层是直接上手引导——就像从看地图变成了亲自划船。”

    “那第四层呢。”

    “丹道真解上没写，徐老头的批注里也没有。但我昨晚在灵境空间里感知到你体内有一丝极其微弱的灵力波动，不是混沌印记带来的，是你自己修炼功法时留下的痕迹。如果你的灵纹感知再往上升一层，应该能直接感知到他人经脉里的灵力流转路径——不只是药材的灵纹，还包括人的。”

    “也就是说，第四层是能感知他人经脉。这种能力在炼丹上没什么用，但在诊断中毒者的时候……”苏荇顿了一下，“你师尊中的血煞爪毒素，如果能用第四层感知力直接看到她经脉里的毒素走向，配解药的时候就能精确到每一处毒灶的位置。”

    “对。不过第四层还早，你现在刚突破第三层，先拿紫鳞果练手。”
content_en:
It takes two days of riding from Wuliucheng to Luoyan Valley.

    Lin Chen and Su Xin left the city gate before dawn and walked northeast along the official road.

    Su Yun rode an old horse borrowed from Old Man Xu, carrying the patched bronze stove on the horse's back. Along the way, she was flipping through the second volume of Alchemy True Solution, the Poison Principle, and murmuring something.

    "The toxicity of the purple scale fruit is not in the pulp, but in the core. There are twelve scale spiritual patterns on the surface of the fruit core. Each scale is an independent small spiritual pattern. After being put into the furnace, the poison of the rotten veins will be released at the same time. The wood attribute spiritual pattern of Qingxin grass encounters the fire attribute scale. The spirit patterns will attack each other - wood creates fire, and the fire attribute's toxicity is intensified during the fusion, so the water attribute of the silver leaf flower is needed as a buffer layer in the middle." She turned to one of the pages of the book, which was full of Old Man Xu's annotations.

    "Water overcomes fire, and water produces wood at the same time. The ratio of the three medicinal materials must be accurate to the density of each plant's spirit pattern. If you make a mistake, the furnace will explode." Lin Chen took the book in her hand and looked at it before returning it to her, "Aren't you afraid of getting dizzy while reading on a horse?"

    "I've been refining elixirs for three years, and I can continue to make medicines when I'm in tears next to the alchemy furnace. Reading a book on horseback is nothing." Su Yun closed the book and stuffed it into the saddle on the horse. "But I do have a question for you - in the spiritual space last night, you said that after the chaos mark was activated, my spiritual pattern perception could break through to the third level. The third level can actively guide the direction of spiritual pattern fusion, but how exactly does it work?"

    "Rely on the resonance of spiritual power. After your spiritual power enters my meridians, the chaotic spiritual power will automatically feed back, and your perception will be tempered during the feedback process. After breaking through to the third level, you can directly 'see' the flow direction of the spiritual patterns in the furnace without a fire viewing mirror, and then guide them to the fusion path you want by adjusting the fire. To put it simply, the first level is to look at the color, the second level is to look at the speed, and the third level is to directly guide - just like changing from looking at a map to rowing a boat yourself."

    "What about the fourth floor?"

    "It's not written in the true explanation of alchemy, and it's not in Old Man Xu's annotations. But I sensed an extremely weak spiritual power fluctuation in your body in the spiritual realm last night. It's not caused by the mark of chaos, but the traces left by your own practice. If your spiritual pattern perception goes up to one level, you should be able to directly perceive the spiritual energy flow path in other people's meridians - not just the spiritual patterns of medicinal materials, but also the spiritual patterns of people."

    "In other words, the fourth level is the ability to sense other people's meridians. This ability is of little use in alchemy, but when diagnosing poisoned people..." Su Yun paused, "The blood evil claw toxin in your master, if you can use the fourth level of perception to directly see the direction of the toxin in her meridians, you can accurately determine the location of each poisonous spot when preparing the antidote."

    "Yes. But it's still early for the fourth level. You have just broken through the third level. Let's practice with the purple scale fruit first."
